title: Enigmatic Device uses the technology research dialog
description: The Enigmatic Device (relic and exploration cards) asked which technology to research with a plain option list of every unowned technology. It now opens the normal technology research dialog: filters, prerequisites, tech skips, and only researchable cards are pickable. The engine (rules version 5) also offers only technologies whose prerequisites are met. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- EY. Synthetic fixture through a mocked server: a seat with no technologies and 8 trade goods.

shots.heading: Before: option list, desktop
shots.caption: A plain list of every technology, including ones whose prerequisites the seat does not have.

shots.heading: After: research dialog, desktop
shots.caption: The normal technology dialog: cards without met prerequisites are dimmed, a pick enables Confirm Research.
